recipes.assumptions: Technical composition control, not a historical verdict.
recipes.limitations: Final-output agreement cannot establish singleton-aw lengthening.

recipes.description: Remove only SC034 privately to measure the complete selected-corpus dependency.
recipes.assumptions: Ablation, not a proposed replacement history. Predicted final changes are confined to 2186,2224,2317,2318; dew and hew must remain unchanged. Straw without the incumbent quantity proxy is predicted to end as straew (CAPR ae glyph), not to acquire regular endingless au automatically.
recipes.limitations: Skipping SC034 does not implement the missing endingless vocalization or paradigm levelling. Any new mismatch is an implementation dependency, not evidence against the cited historical analysis.

recipes.description: Separate a late-SC034 fronting confound from the direct early-apocope counterfactual.
recipes.assumptions: Delaying SC034 across both SC043 and SC047 is predicted to affect all four singleton applications because fronting consumes their a. Inherited dew/hew controls should retain their finals.
recipes.limitations: This does not reproduce the historical card's one-row experiment, which moved SC047 earlier instead. It separates the fronting confound from that direct apocope dependency; neither establishes historical chronology.

recipes.description: Reproduce the old one-row straw boundary by moving only nasal apocope before SC034.
recipes.assumptions: Predicted changed final set is exactly straw2224. Its final nasal vowel should be lost before SC034, removing the following-vowel condition; without implemented final-w vocalization the suffix is predicted to yield short straew rather than regular endingless long strea. Show2186/2317/2318 and inherited dew/hew should retain their finals.
recipes.limitations: This diagnoses the current proxy and missing endingless consumer. A short counterfactual straw output does not refute the sources' earlier endingless vocalization or establish an independent historical SC047-to-SC034 edge.

recipes.description: Privately test the source-reconstructed inherited endingless straw line, leaving selected corpus fields and show's disputed proxy unchanged.
recipes.assumptions: The composed fragment serializes final short-a loss and resulting final-w vocalization together for the inherited aw-a endingless domain. It does not assert vowel loss was historically conditioned by w. The au product must feed existing SC030 and SC032 rather than a new singleton prevocalic lengthening law. Predicted changed final set is exactly straw2224: strea with long ea and no restored w.
recipes.limitations: The free West Saxon endingless target is reconstructed, not attested. This is a private test of a regular historical branch, not adoption of a new selected target, a universal final-vowel-loss rule or a settled show history. The exact holding site does not establish chronology among unrelated early operations. The selected nasal vowel is CAPR's inherited-neuter notation. Unaccented, nonfinal and geminate component inputs are hypothetical notation/finality/class controls, not attested lexemes; Campbell pp.45-47 distinguishes the two glide histories.

recipes.description: Test source-distinct regular endingless and post-levelling straw suffixes without adopting either selected comparison.
recipes.assumptions: The inherited endingless long diphthong without w is a reconstructed pre-levelling endpoint, not a free attested West Saxon simplex. The long diphthong with restored w is a post-levelling English-stage input, not PGmc. The suffix entry is an executable checkpoint, not independent historical dating of levelling.
recipes.limitations: These suffix diagnostics cannot establish a surviving regular paradigm cell, date the analogy before the checkpoint, or authorize an input/target/stage/fingerprint migration. They quantify the bounded regular tails, rather than rescue the current selected PGmc-to-OE proxy.
